_comment: MoneyLife Military engine settings (ADR 0008). Rates are NOT here: VA compensation and retirement multipliers are read from data/reference/compensation.json so there is one copy of every number. These are limits, vocabularies, scenario defaults and wording.

always_hypothetical.va_illustration: An illustration from a rate table is not an award. It is counted as hypothetical only.
always_hypothetical.proposed_legislation: Proposed law isn't current law. It is counted as hypothetical only, never in confirmed income.

scenario_defaults._note: Assumptions, shown to the person and editable. Not research findings.

citations.va_active_duty: 38 U.S.C. 5304(c): VA compensation isn't paid for any period in which the person receives active-service pay.
citations.concurrent_receipt: 10 U.S.C. 1414 (CRDP) and 1413a (CRSC); 38 U.S.C. 5304-5305 (VA waiver of retired pay).
citations.regular_multiplier: 10 U.S.C. 1409(b): 2.5% per year (High-3), 2.0% per year (Blended Retirement System).
citations.reserve_points: 10 U.S.C. 12733: years of service for retired pay = points / 360.
citations.chapter61: 10 U.S.C. 1401: disability retired pay uses the greater of the years-of-service or the DoD disability percentage method, capped at 75%.

disclaimer: An estimate from the numbers you entered and dated rate tables. It isn't financial, tax or legal advice, and it isn't a VA, DFAS or lender decision. Check amounts with the paying agency.
